status.description: done: every acceptance criterion is met and verified. partial: some work landed but at least one criterion is unmet. blocked: you stopped because you could not proceed without a decision or access you do not have.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what you changed and why.

criteria.description: One entry per acceptance criterion in the brief, by its id.

id.description: The criterion's id from the brief, e.g. AC1.

evidence.description: The command you ran and what it showed, or why this is unmet or unverified.

commands.description: Every verification command you actually ran. Do not list a command you did not run.

result.description: One line: pass/fail counts or the first error.

deviations.description: Anything you did that the brief did not ask for, or did differently from the plan, and why. Empty if none.

blocked_checks.description: Checks you could not run (sandbox, network, missing toolchain) and the exact error. Empty if none.

open_questions.description: Decisions you need from the reviewer. Required when status is blocked. Empty if none.
